    """A route with a sub-1s pacing wait must be deferred; only a ready
    alternative route may be called immediately.
    """

    monkeypatch.setenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY", value)
    monkeypatch.setenv("NVIDIA_API_KEY", value)

    primary_profile = RouterProfile(
        model=Model.GEMINI_FLASH,
        provider=Provider.GOOGLE,
    )
    fallback_profile = RouterProfile(
        model=Model.DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH,
        provider=Provider.NVIDIA,
    )
    router = LLMRouter(
        [primary_profile, fallback_profile],
        shuffle_fallbacks=False,
        round_robin_start=False,
    )
    runtime = getattr(router, "_runtime", router)

    orig_prepare = runtime._prepare_request

    def fake_prepare(
        *,
        request_id: str,
        route: Any,
        settings: Any,
        content: Any,
    ) -> tuple[Any, float]:
        request, _ = orig_prepare(
            request_id=request_id,
            route=route,
            settings=settings,
            content=content,
        )
        wait_seconds = 0.5 if route.provider == Provider.GOOGLE else 0.0
        return request, wait_seconds

    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_prepare_request", fake_prepare)

    called_providers: list[Provider] = []
    sentinel = object()

    async def fake_call_async(
        request: Any,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> object:
        called_providers.append(request.route.provider)
        return sentinel
